user.title: Connect Aquarisma
user.description: Aquarisma opens in your browser. The password stays there and is not saved in Home Assistant. Reading is requested by default. Writing is optional and can be left off.

data.use_my_home_assistant: Use My Home Assistant for the return address
data.allow_write: Also request permission to record feeding, care, water changes and readings

data_description.base_url: The address of your Aquarisma site. No path, no user name and no password. HTTP is only accepted for localhost and private addresses.
data_description.use_my_home_assistant: Recommended. Turn this off only when this Home Assistant instance has a public address and you want the browser to return directly to /auth/external/callback.
data_description.allow_write: Home Assistant can then confirm a single planned feeding, complete one care task, and record a water change or a manual reading. It never doses, feeds hardware, or changes a schedule by itself.

reconfigure.title: Update Aquarisma
reconfigure.description: Change the address or the write permission. You will sign in again. Devices stay until the next complete snapshot.

data.use_my_home_assistant: Use My Home Assistant for the return address
data.allow_write: Also request permission to record feeding, care, water changes and readings

data_description.base_url: The address of your Aquarisma site, without a path or a password.
data_description.use_my_home_assistant: Recommended unless this Home Assistant instance is reached through its own public address.
data_description.allow_write: Turn this on to record care from Home Assistant. Existing read access stays available either way.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Aquarisma
reauth_confirm.description: The saved sign-in is no longer accepted. Sign in again. Devices and history stay until a new complete snapshot says an aquarium is gone.

error.cannot_connect: Aquarisma could not be reached. Check the address and that this Home Assistant instance is allowed to connect.
error.invalid_url: Enter the site address only. A path, a password in the address, or plain HTTP on a public host is not accepted.
error.no_external_url: This Home Assistant instance has no external address. Leave My Home Assistant enabled, or set an external URL in the Home Assistant network settings.

abort.already_configured: This Aquarisma connection is already set up.
abort.oauth_state: The sign-in could not be matched to this attempt. Start the connection again.
abort.oauth_token: Aquarisma did not accept the sign-in.
abort.wrong_account: This sign-in belongs to a different Aquarisma connection.

init.title: Aquarisma
init.description: How often Home Assistant asks Aquarisma for a snapshot. The server also enforces its own minimum and maximum.

data_description.poll_interval: Seconds between snapshots. Allowed values are 30 to 300. A shorter interval does not make a manual test a live sensor.

unsupported_schema.title: Aquarisma sent a snapshot this version cannot read
unsupported_schema.description: The snapshot uses schema {schema}. Existing devices were left unchanged. Update the Aquarisma integration before relying on these entities.

empty_snapshot.title: Aquarisma returned no aquariums
empty_snapshot.description: The connection is signed in, but no aquarium is shared with it. Check the grants in Aquarisma. An empty list is not a connection error, and previously removed devices stay removed.

aquarium_overlap.title: {name} is managed by another Aquarisma connection
aquarium_overlap.description: More than one connection can see {name}. Home Assistant keeps a single device and leaves it with the connection that was created first. Remove the extra grant, or accept that this connection will not create a second device.

aquarium_not_managed.message: This aquarium is not managed by an Aquarisma connection.

action_not_allowed.message: Aquarisma refused the action. The connection may be missing the write permission, or the sign-in has expired.

action_rejected.message: Aquarisma rejected the action. Check the aquarium, the plan and the value.

idempotency_conflict.message: This idempotency key was already used for a different action. Use a new key for a new action.

invalid_idempotency_key.message: The idempotency key must be 8 to 80 characters and may contain only letters, numbers, dots, underscores, colons and hyphens.

api_error.message: Aquarisma could not complete the action: {detail}

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch a new snapshot for every Aquarisma connection.

confirm_feeding.name: Confirm feeding
confirm_feeding.description: Confirm one planned feeding. The plan, slot and date must identify that single feeding.

aquarium_id.name: Aquarium
aquarium_id.description: External id of the aquarium. It is the device identifier, not the display name.

date.name: Date
date.description: Aquarium-local date of the feeding, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

idempotency_key.name: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key of 8 to 80 characters. Repeat the same key to retry the same action safely.

complete_care.name: Complete care task
complete_care.description: Complete one care task by its occurrence id.

occurrence_id.name: Occurrence
occurrence_id.description: Id of the single care occurrence to complete.

idempotency_key.name: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key of 8 to 80 characters.

record_water_change.name: Record water change
record_water_change.description: Record a water change with an explicit volume. There is no default amount.

liters.name: Liters
liters.description: Volume of water changed, in liters.

idempotency_key.name: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key of 8 to 80 characters.

record_measurement.name: Record measurement
record_measurement.description: Record one manual water reading. A manual reading is never treated as a live sensor.

parameter.name: Parameter
parameter.description: Parameter key, for example temperature or nitrite.

value.name: Value
value.description: The reading, in the unit you send or in the aquarium default.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Optional unit code, for example celsius or mg_l.

measured_at.name: Measured at
measured_at.description: Optional time of the reading. Omit it to use the current time.

confirm_unusual.name: Confirm unusual value
confirm_unusual.description: Set this when Aquarisma asked for confirmation because the value is far from the expected range.

idempotency_key.name: Idempotency key
idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key of 8 to 80 characters.
